objects: a set of points {x1,...,xn} in R^F together with a directed k-NN graph, recomputed after every layer
assumptions: point cloud is an unordered set, so operations must be permutation-invariant
local structure represented via a k-nearest-neighbor graph
guarantees: formal: EdgeConv output is permutation-invariant, since max is a symmetric aggregation function
formal: EdgeConv has partial translation invariance
empirical claim only for classification/segmentation accuracy (state-of-the-art on ModelNet40, ShapeNet, S3DIS)
formalism.operation: compute a learned edge feature for each point-neighbor pair, aggregate over the point's current k nearest neighbors with a max operation, and dynamically recompute the neighbor graph from each layer's output features

evidence_spans.objects: Consider an F-dimensional point cloud with n points, denoted by X = {x1, . . . , xn} in R^F.
evidence_spans.assumptions: we construct G as the k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) graph of X in R^F
evidence_spans.guarantees: The output of the layer x'i is invariant to permutation of the input xj because max is a symmetric function
